title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Let n >= 2 and let X_1,...,X_n be independent Uniform[0,1] random variables. Set S=(X_1,...,X_n).
Let f_S:[0,1]->[0,1] be any jointly measurable function selected using S. Write P f_S = integral_0^1 f_S(x) dx.
For every t > 0, P(|n^{-1} sum_{i=1}^n f_S(X_i) - P f_S| >= t) <= 2 exp(-2 n t^2).
Proof. Conditional on S, the function f_S is fixed and the X_i remain independent Uniform[0,1].
Hoeffding's inequality conditional on S bounds the displayed event by 2 exp(-2 n t^2).
Integrating the conditional bound over S proves the claim.

conclusions.claim: P(|P_n f_S - P f_S| >= t) <= 2 exp(-2 n t^2)
